<div class="card">
<div class="lab" style="margin: 0">How the states are read</div>
<div class="item"><div><span class="chip state green">current</span></div><div class="cap" style="flex:1">The rule is met in the newest report, or the suite's newest clean run passed within 7 days.</div></div>
<div class="item"><div><span class="chip state amber">stale</span></div><div class="cap" style="flex:1">The newest report or clean run is older than 7 days, or no clean run exists.</div></div>
<div class="item"><div><span class="chip state red">failing</span></div><div class="cap" style="flex:1">A budget is over, a pin is behind, a measure is not 0, or the newest run failed a case.</div></div>
<div class="item"><div><span class="chip state grey">no report</span></div><div class="cap" style="flex:1">The repository's newest main run uploaded no report, so its rules have no state.</div></div>
